text: The pilot camera showed the captain upright at 2.3 s and then slumped with head dropped and hands off the controls at 13.5 s. Crosscheck said "Captain, are you OK?" at 19.7 s and then said "Captain not responding. First officer, take control." at 29.9 s. The calls followed the change at 10.0 s and matched the recorded ground truth, so speaking up was right.
